meetings.title: Strategy due-diligence meeting
meetings.summary: Strategy due-diligence meeting with Richard Anderson on the Capital Group International Equity allocation. Anderson raised questions on recent relative performance; flagged internally to firm up a retention plan.

decisions.text: Continue due diligence on International Equity with a performance attribution follow-up.

action_items.text: Escalate retention plan for Cordova Technologies

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Richard Anderson
transcript_excerpt.text: I want to understand the recent relative performance before we re-up.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Marcus Hale
transcript_excerpt.text: Fair - I'll bring a detailed attribution and a plan to address it.

meetings.title: Consultant intro call
meetings.summary: Consultant intro call with Richard Anderson and RVK. Relationship in good standing; no action required at the time.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Richard Anderson
transcript_excerpt.text: RVK is comfortable with the relationship as it stands.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Marcus Hale
transcript_excerpt.text: Glad to hear it - we'll keep delivering.
